comments.note: FakeFfprobeRunner.cs: Clean, idiomatic test double. Case-insensitive dictionary, fluent Register() returning this, CallCount/LastPath observability, and CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested() at call entry are all correct. No Blocking issues.

TempVideoFolder.cs: Guid-based temp directory naming avoids collisions. IDisposable.Dispose is idempotent (Directory.Exists guard). Edge case: if Directory.CreateDirectory or File.WriteAllBytes throws in the constructor, any partially created directory will not be cleaned up (IDisposable is not called on a constructor-throwing instance by language semantics). For a test fixture in a controlled environment this is a non-issue — noted for completeness.

ExtensionObfuscationMapTests.cs: Comprehensive coverage — all 10 native-to-obfuscated mappings, .res reverse-lookup insertion-order rule, unknown extension false/null, IsObfuscated for all 9 obfuscated extensions, case-insensitivity, leading-dot tolerance, and collection counts (10 real, 9 obfuscated). Well-structured and readable.
